beats.headline: A god through Uzzi
beats.text: Odette's crawlers spent half the tenth floor hunting the dart, only to learn the puzzle needed a storm god. They have summoned two, Dodola has sent the other away, the timer is running, and Mordecai has a plan that will kill him. Odette has another: worship Dodola, then use the dart. It cannot be used on oneself, and Hold Steady is keeping the puzzle primed, so it has to be Uzzi. Chaco worships Dodola. Uzzi looks down at the dart in his hand, caws a war cry and spreads his wings. Chaco throws it into his breast. Uzzi's chest rips open as Dodola forms inside Chaco's containment with the puzzle, which shatters into the key. Her own lightning ends her. Did they use the dart on his brother, Mordecai asks.
